content:
Apple earlier today released macOS 27.2 beta 1, and is now rolling out the first RC versions of macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1. Here are the details.

The RC versions of macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 are now available

Apple today released the first developer beta of its 27.2 operating system, completely skipping the 27.1 beta cycle — a decision likely aimed at avoiding further leaks about the iPhone Duo.

For Mac developers, in addition to releasing macOS 27.2 beta 1, Apple has simultaneously launched the first release candidate (RC) versions of macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1.

The two release notes only mention the default boilerplate, "This update provides important security fixes and is recommended for all users," which is expected for minor updates.

The arrival of these RC versions comes just days after Apple officially released macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8, further reflecting the company's broader direction of accelerating software development and bug fixes with the assistance of AI-powered tools.

The macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 RC 1 build number is 25G309, while the first RC of macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 carries the build number 24H208.

Have you spotted anything new in these RCs? Drop a comment and let us know.
